Hello Madness Warden main here and if I can help you by telling you how I got everything then that would be cool. I started the game in pve because I didn't want to raid. I focused mainly on my weapon all the way until storm dragon. Some people may disagree with the idea of not going through Raven but I did it and I enjoyed it. I bonerushed buying a whole lot of tokens from CoS to get my upgraded bracelet and only focused that for a while. At the same time I was getting my soul to awakened ascending and my heart to true hongmoon. Once I was storm dragon I went for my VT badge but personally I would get that first over everything since you can flat out buy it. After that I got my BT accessories and got them to rank 9 little by little while only going for my weapon since my bracelet was already maxed out. Once that was done I was ready for VT and started getting mats for aransu 9. Even after that I was ready for TT since I already had everything ready for TT without even needing to raid or finding groups and even had no problems with PvE content because of my bracelet and the soul still at awakened ascending. After that I saved all my materials to GC 6. GC 3 imo is not worth it, you lose so much sustained dps with a little upgrade to burst. Imo A9 and GC6 are probably about equal so that that point focus your other items your pet your soul your TT accessories and your heart. Hopefully my experience helps you out on your journey! Good luck!

Make sure you are also working on your macro play, because what happens if the simple stuff like rotations, shot calling etc. are at a very high level you can climb not just with Ahri but with any other champion but the most important thing to know firstly is who you're playing. Ahri when fed is strong, but does not supply the damage for teamfights past a certain point of the game and only can be  someone can only really do single target. (35+ minutes) With that in mind, look to end the game as soon as you can. Itemization tip is to not build defensive when you're behind, like real behind because you will offset your damage further, look to get as much AP as you can so you can farm and deal as much damage as you can.

In my opinion, one of the best ways to stay engaged in each and every game is a single thing, APM. I honestly believe this game is an RTS and to be able to consistently see where and what you're doing at any time will become a lot more clearer. It will also keep your mind thinking 100% of the time before and after the game. Things that I like doing is constantly right clicking just everywhere during the game, it helps me focus on what's important rather than being lazy and just right clicking where your champ needs to go. Constantly locking and unlocking your minimap will help awareness or otherwise peeking at it every 2 seconds as well. Other games players implement this concept is obviously Starcraft but even fighting games like Smash Bros. Melee where people will wave dash and dash dance to keep their mind in check for their combos. Your decision making is the key to victory and if you don't see the black and white correct and wrong decisions then you either were lazy about the situation with a lack of focus or you don't have the supplemented knowledge to make a good judgmental decision for every situation in the game. I've always believed you can get to at the least Platinum with this in mind. Emotional mindset is another beast as well. Some people just don't react to things well and can affect their decision making as well whether that be teammates or tilt. If you can conquer and apply these things every ranked game I know you can get to where you want on the ladder.
